guide.conditionalHint: Refreshes use the browser's conditional HTTP cache when the provider supports it, avoiding unchanged downloads.

theatre.archiveGuideNote: Explore these collections on their source sites. Individual editions, restorations and territorial rights need their own review.

midnight.title: Midnight monsters
midnight.description: Haunted houses, unexpected visitors and science gone wrong. Start with the archive’s science-fiction and horror collection.

noir.title: Shadows & double-crosses
noir.description: Private eyes, dangerous bargains and the wrong turn home. Explore crime films from the 1940s and 1950s.

silent.title: Before the first word
silent.description: Visual comedy, impossible journeys and early screen nightmares. Discover silent cinema, with attention to each copy’s score and restoration.

archiveCatalog.title: Explore archives
archiveCatalog.ratingsNote: Archive stars rate a particular upload. Best rated balances stars with the number of reviews; these are not IMDb ratings.
archiveCatalog.imageConsent: Source images connect to Archive.org, Public Domain Movies or YouTube. Text-only browsing stays on CATODO.
archiveCatalog.entryContext: {year} · {kind}. {languages} Read the synopsis and edition notes on the source page.
archiveCatalog.rightsNote: This is a discovery index. Directory membership and uploader license labels do not approve an edition for Theatre. Source links open the original sites; only reviewed editions have an in-app film button.
archiveCatalog.scopeNote: The index includes Archive’s feature_films collection and the direct entries in the two directories. Linked collections remain single collection entries; similar titles can be different editions. Years and categories follow source metadata.
archiveCatalog.failed: The archive index could not load. Your reviewed films are still available.

featured.title: Featured
featured.heading: A different kind of movie night.
featured.lead: Silent inventions, midnight monsters and futures that never arrived. An editorial journey through 305 films and archive discoveries.
featured.sourceNote: Explore each film on its source site. Editions and international availability vary; viewing notes explain what has been checked. Source images load only when enabled.
featured.empty: No films match. Try another collection or reset the filters.
featured.notCleared: This research entry is not an approval for worldwide in-app playback.
featured.failed: Featured is temporarily unavailable. Try again or browse Curated films.
